summary: Round r1 (restricted network; data hosts blocked). All empirical items are PENDING. Q1 (manufacturing share of GDP and employment, trend), Q2 (sectors with revealed comparative advantage) and Q3 (landed-cost disadvantage of landlocked logistics) are designed but unanswered. Primary documents located: NSO national accounts and microdata catalogue (Census 2021, NLFS 2017/18, Census of Manufacturing Establishments), MoF Economic Surveys, WDI API, ILOSTAT, customs Foreign Trade Statistics and Nepal Trade Portal, UN Comtrade, UNCTADstat, ITC Trade Map, WTO TPR (2025), LPI 2023, World Bank and ADB transit-corridor project documents, NITDB and ESCAP dry-port material, UNCTAD RMT 2025, and landlockedness literature. Designed: (i) a manufacturing profile (ISIC C) with base-year splicing and separate real/deflator effects; (ii) a Balassa RCA table on mirror data with 3-year windows and flags for preference dependence, tariff arbitrage and electricity intensity (link to 05B); (iii) a landed-cost decomposition per TEU plus time cost against coastal and landlocked comparators. Reported 2026 logistics and market-access changes are unverified pointers only.

findings.claim: Manufacturing (ISIC section C) GVA share of GDP at current basic prices, FY2000/01-FY2025/26.
findings.note: NSO national accounts; WDI NV.IND.MANF.ZS as cross-check (calendar-labelled; conversion must be documented). Splice across base-year revisions with the method recorded. Leads: 05C-L01, 05C-L02, 05C-L03, 05C-L04, 05C-L05

findings.claim: Manufacturing real GVA growth (constant prices) and share at constant prices.
findings.note: Keep real growth and deflator effects separate (CLAUDE.md rule 6). Leads: 05C-L01, 05C-L04

findings.claim: Manufacturing employment level and share of total employment (NLFS 2017/18; Census 2021; ILOSTAT modelled).
findings.note: Definitions differ (usual vs current status, main vs any job, age cut-offs); keep all values with notes. Leads: 05C-L06, 05C-L07, 05C-L08

findings.claim: Census of Manufacturing Establishments: establishments, persons engaged, gross output, value added by ISIC 2-digit division.
findings.note: Formal establishments with a size threshold; not comparable with national-accounts GVA without reconciliation. Leads: 05C-L07

findings.claim: Manufacturing labour productivity (GVA per worker) relative to economy-wide average.
findings.note: Estimate only after GVA and employment are observations for matched periods. Leads: 05C-L01, 05C-L06, 05C-L07

findings.claim: Merchandise exports by HS 4/6-digit, Nepal-reported, FY2015/16-FY2025/26.
findings.note: Customs FTS books and Nepal Trade Portal queries. Leads: 05C-L10, 05C-L11, 05C-L12, 05C-L13

findings.claim: Partner-reported (mirror) imports from Nepal and world exports by HS 6-digit, calendar 2015-2025.
findings.note: Mirror data used for RCA denominator consistency; CIF/FOB and timing differences documented. Leads: 05C-L14, 05C-L15, 05C-L16, 05C-L18

findings.claim: Balassa RCA index by HS 4-digit product, 3-year averages, and list of products with RCA > 1 persisting over two consecutive windows.
findings.note: Method in specific.rca_table; UNCTADstat/WITS published RCA as cross-check. Leads: 05C-L14, 05C-L15, 05C-L16, 05C-L17, 05C-L18

findings.claim: Share of RCA products whose exports depend on tariff preferences (LDC/SAFTA margins) or tariff arbitrage (inputs imported at low tariff, minimal processing, re-export to India).
findings.note: Requires preference margins and domestic value-added share; flags RCA that would not survive LDC graduation or rules-of-origin tightening. Leads: 05C-L19, 05C-L20, 05C-L21, 05C-L22, 05C-L10

findings.claim: World Bank LPI 2023 overall and component scores for Nepal and comparators (Bangladesh, Bhutan, Laos, Rwanda, Uganda, India).
findings.note: Survey-based; perception measure, not cost; component 'international shipments' and KPI dwell times used. Leads: 05C-L23, 05C-L24

findings.claim: Landed-cost components for a standard container: ocean freight to Kolkata/Haldia and Visakhapatnam; port handling; rail/road transit to Birgunj/Biratnagar ICDs; border/customs; inland to plant.
findings.note: Project documents give baseline vintages; current tariffs from NITDB and Indian port schedules. Comparator: coastal gateway to inland city in Bangladesh and India. Leads: 05C-L25, 05C-L26, 05C-L27, 05C-L28, 05C-L29, 05C-L34

findings.claim: Transit and dwell time door-to-door (import and export) and its ad valorem time-cost equivalent.
findings.note: Time cost converted using a per-day ad valorem rate from the literature (assumption to be registered). Leads: 05C-L24, 05C-L25, 05C-L27

findings.claim: Industrial electricity tariff and supply reliability (outage hours/losses reported by manufacturing firms).
findings.note: NEA tariff schedule; Enterprise Survey obstacles (URL unverified). Shared with 05A/05B. Leads: 05C-L43, 05C-L40

findings.claim: Reported 2026 changes to landlocked logistics: Kolkata-Biratnagar rail cargo service and Indian ECTS amendment; Indian import-side measures on Nepali exports.
findings.note: UNVERIFIED media pointers; primary notifications required before any cost change is modelled. Leads: 05C-L32, 05C-L33

findings.claim: Manufacturing is defined as ISIC Rev.4 section C throughout; electricity (section D) and mining/construction are excluded.
RCA uses the Balassa index on mirror-plus-reported data with 3-year averaging; RCA is a descriptive indicator of export specialisation, not evidence of cost competitiveness.
findings.note: RCA can be inflated by preferences, tariff arbitrage and re-exports; flagged per product.

findings.claim: Landlocked cost disadvantage is the difference between Nepal's door-to-door landed cost and a coastal comparator's cost for the same cargo and origin port, expressed per TEU and as ad valorem equivalent; it excludes tariffs.

data_gaps: Every empirical value: no primary document could be downloaded in r1.
Document-level NSO endpoints for national accounts, NLFS and the Census of Manufacturing Establishments are unverified.
Customs FTS books FY2023/24-FY2025/26 not located (only FY2022/23 book).
Current per-TEU freight, handling and transit tariffs on India-Nepal corridors: only project-document baselines of older vintage located; current NITDB/Indian port tariffs needed.
Domestic value-added share by export product (to test tariff-arbitrage RCA) - no source located.
Enterprise Survey, WITS and CEPII BACI URLs are from general knowledge (unverified); Comtrade bulk access may need an API key.

assumptions.text: RCA computed on calendar-year mirror data; Nepal FY customs data used as check, not mixed.
Landed-cost disadvantage excludes tariffs and is measured relative to named comparators.
A per-day ad valorem time-cost rate will be taken from peer-reviewed literature and registered in config/model_config.yaml as an assumption (not yet chosen).
Media reports are pointers only, never evidence.

challenges.text: Enterprise Surveys, WITS and CEPII BACI are not in the source catalog; propose adding (tier 2/2/7). Comtrade bulk access may require an API key - access decision needed before r2.

Hand-off: the RCA table carries an electricity-intensity flag; 05B should supply the electricity-intensity classification by HS/ISIC so the export-vs-domestic-use comparison targets sectors with plausible RCA, not hypothetical ones.
Ocean-freight shocks (Hormuz/Red Sea) enter the landed-cost model through the ocean leg only; please confirm 19C will publish freight indices on a gateway-port basis (Kolkata/Visakhapatnam).
RCA products flagged as preference-dependent should be cross-checked against 21A's list of lines losing LDC preferences.
Escalation: if reported 2026 changes (Kolkata-Biratnagar rail service; Indian import-side measures; transit-treaty review) are verified, landed-cost and export-access baselines change for S02/S03.

uncertainty: High: no value retrieved. Structural uncertainties: (i) NSO base-year revisions break manufacturing share series; (ii) employment definitions differ across NLFS, Census and ILOSTAT; (iii) Nepal-reported vs mirror trade differ (CIF/FOB, timing, informal India trade); (iv) RCA may reflect preferences or tariff arbitrage rather than competitiveness; (v) logistics cost data are project-baseline vintages and may not reflect current tariffs or 2026 route changes; (vi) time-cost conversion depends on a literature parameter.

manufacturing_profile.trend_method: Level and share series spliced across NSO base-year revisions (overlap-ratio splice, documented); trend compared with Rodrik (2016) share-income benchmark and comparators (Bangladesh, Bhutan, Laos, Rwanda) from WDI - descriptive only
methodological_issues: Base-year rebasing breaks in NSO series
Nepal FY vs WDI calendar labelling
Employment definitions differ between NLFS, Census and ILOSTAT modelled estimates

rca_table.method: Balassa RCA_ij = (x_ij / X_i) / (x_wj / X_w); i = Nepal, j = HS 4-digit product, w = world; symmetric RCA = (RCA-1)/(RCA+1) also reported
rca_table.data: Nepal exports: partner-reported mirror imports (Comtrade/BACI) as primary, Nepal customs (FY) as check; world exports: Comtrade/BACI; calendar years
rca_table.classification: HS2017 with concordance to HS2022; SITC Rev.3 via UNCTADstat for cross-check
rca_table.rows_status: pending - no trade data retrieved; product names are not pre-listed to avoid unsourced claims

cost_disadvantage_estimates.definition: Landed-cost disadvantage = Nepal door-to-door cost (gateway port -> Nepal ICD -> plant) minus coastal comparator cost for the same cargo, plus time cost; per TEU and ad valorem equivalent (percent of cargo value)

components.component: ocean freight to Indian gateway (Kolkata/Haldia, Visakhapatnam)
port handling and transit documentation (ECTS, bonds)
border and customs clearance at ICD

components.method: days x per-day ad valorem rate (literature value, registered as assumption)

cost_disadvantage_estimates.decomposition_reference: Limao and Venables (2001): own-infrastructure vs transit-country vs distance
scenario_hooks: Kolkata-Biratnagar rail service and ECTS amendment (reported 2026, unverified)
